task: Implement and adopt canonical VX Smart Intent: a deterministic, bounded merchant-intent compiler that translates contextual Hungarian/English editing intent into previewable existing Builder/responsive/typography/global-token operations, applies them only after explicit user action through ordinary undoable Page Schema history, and fails closed on ambiguous, stale or unsupported intent.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: VX Smart Intent is the next mandatory Brabus blocker after lifecycle-closed Publish Readiness. The existing Block 23 AI storefront generator chooses templates and copy for a full draft, but it is not an in-Builder intent compiler. Smart Intent must operate inside the active Builder and translate bounded contextual requests such as making an image larger, adding whitespace, emphasizing a title, hiding an element on mobile or resetting an override into existing canonical Builder authorities. It must not generate source code, invent schema fields, act from diagnostics, auto-publish, or become Smart Auto-Fix.
observableOutcomes: One canonical Smart Intent Core accepts contextual merchant text plus selected node/current viewport and returns deterministic READY/BLOCK/UNKNOWN plans.
The parser supports bounded Hungarian and English intent families for layout width, spacing/token density, typography emphasis, visibility and responsive reset.
Unrecognized, contradictory or multi-action ambiguous text returns UNKNOWN with zero operations rather than guessing.
Every READY operation names its existing source authority and explanation; no Smart Intent-specific Page Schema mutation primitive is introduced.
Width intent uses the existing 12-column authority and, for a two-child 12-column pair, preserves the total by complementing the sibling (for example 6/12 + 6/12 becomes 8/12 + 4/12).
Spacing intent uses existing responsive grid/stack gap tokens or explicit global spacingScale tokens; arbitrary CSS is never emitted.
Typography intent uses the existing sanitized responsive typography authority and bounded token/size ranges.
Visibility/reset intent uses the proven responsive layout-depth authority and explicit viewport context.
Plans bind to the source page fingerprint; applying a stale plan fails closed.
Applying a plan reuses existing canonical setters, validates the resulting Page Schema, and never publishes or persists by itself.
Active StorefrontVisualBuilderV3 exposes plan/preview/apply controls; apply commits exactly one ordinary Builder history entry, preserving undo/redo.
Smart Intent never derives mutations from Publish Readiness, Visual Diff or diagnostics; that diagnostics-to-repair boundary remains reserved for Smart Auto-Fix.
VX-SMART-INTENT becomes PROVEN only after Core plus active V3 adoption and executable adversarial proof; VX-SMART-AUTOFIX remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
unresolvedRisks: A vague phrase such as 'make it bigger' could be misclassified between width and typography.
A request mentioning multiple independent edits could silently generate a partial plan.
A width increase could break a balanced two-column row if the companion is not adjusted.
Spacing could be implemented as arbitrary CSS instead of the existing spacing token authority.
Typography scaling could bypass sanitizer bounds or overwrite unrelated typography settings.
Viewport language could be ignored, causing a mobile request to mutate desktop state.
A plan could be applied after the document changed, producing stale or surprising mutations.
V3 could apply Smart Intent directly without ordinary history, breaking undo/redo.
Smart Intent could accidentally consume diagnostics and become an undeclared Auto-Fix system.
The existing Block 23 AI generator could be mistaken for Smart Intent authority or modified unnecessarily.

in: Deterministic contextual intent parsing for bounded Hungarian and English editing phrases.
Intent families: layout width, whitespace/spacing, typography emphasis, viewport visibility, responsive reset, explicit global spacing density.
Existing 12-column grid balancing for canonical two-child pairs.
Source-page fingerprint provenance and stale-plan rejection.
Read-only plan/preview contract with explainable operation authority and affected node/viewport metadata.
Explicit apply through existing responsive layout-depth, fidelity typography, global styles and Page Schema validation authorities.
Active V3 plan/preview/apply UI using one ordinary history commit.
Adversarial tests for ambiguity, contradictions, bounds, stale fingerprint, pair balancing, viewport targeting, unsupported component and diagnostics separation.
Maturity promotion only with active V3 executable evidence.
out: General-purpose natural-language AI or external model invocation.
Arbitrary source-code, HTML, CSS, JavaScript or JSON generation.
Direct save, publish, persistence or commerce mutation.
Diagnostics-driven mutation generation, Smart Auto-Fix or automatic repair.
New responsive, typography, token, Page Schema or Runtime authority.
Control Plane, guard or policy changes.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Smart Intent converts human language into schema mutations, so false interpretation is more dangerous than a missed convenience. The highest practical assurance is a finite bounded grammar with contextual disambiguation, explicit UNKNOWN/BLOCK states, source fingerprint freshness, canonical-operation-only compilation, adversarial phrase matrices, final schema validation and active UI proof. A general probabilistic language model is deliberately outside this capability because deterministic fail-closed behavior is required before Smart Auto-Fix.

acceptanceCriteria: Smart Intent Core has a versioned contract and produces only READY, BLOCK or UNKNOWN plans.
UNKNOWN and BLOCK contain zero executable operations and cannot be applied.
Equivalent normalized phrase/context/document inputs produce deep-equal plans apart from the cryptographic source fingerprint.
Ambiguous family matches, contradictory direction words and multi-action requests fail closed instead of selecting the first match.
Viewport terms in the phrase override current viewport only when exactly one supported viewport is explicit.
Width changes stay within 1..12; a balanced two-child 12-column pair remains exactly 12 columns after resize.
Spacing changes use only STOREFRONT_RESPONSIVE_LAYOUT_SPACING or STOREFRONT_GLOBAL_SPACING_SCALES values.
Typography changes use setStorefrontNodeTypography-compatible sanitized values and preserve unrelated typography fields.
Responsive reset uses resetStorefrontResponsiveLayoutDepth and visibility uses setStorefrontResponsiveVisibility.
Global spacing uses get/setStorefrontGlobalStyleState and never writes raw metadata directly.
Apply rejects a source fingerprint mismatch before any operation executes.
Final apply validates the page with validateStorefrontPageDocument; invalid output throws and no partial document is returned.
V3 exposes a merchant-facing Smart Intent field with separate plan and apply actions; it does not apply on typing or on plan generation.
V3 apply uses commitDocument exactly once for a READY plan, making the change an ordinary undoable history entry.
V3 does not call the Block 23 AI generator, Publish Readiness diagnostics or Visual Diff to synthesize Smart Intent operations.
Production maturity promotes only VX-SMART-INTENT; VX-SMART-AUTOFIX remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED and Template #3 remains blocked.
invariants: Merchant intent is not mutation authority; only compiled canonical operations are.
No plan is executable unless its status is READY.
UNKNOWN never degrades to READY because a target node happens to support one interpretation.
One intent request represents one semantic edit family; independent multi-action requests are rejected.
Current Page Schema, component registry and capability context remain authoritative.
Responsive inheritance is base plus explicit exact-viewport override; Smart Intent does not revive legacy breakpoint cascade.
Smart Intent is user-driven and never diagnostics-driven.
Every apply is stale-safe, schema-valid and ordinary-history compatible.
Smart Intent does not publish, persist or modify business data.

failureModes: Selected image receives typography scaling from the word 'bigger' despite image context.
Phrase says 'larger and add more space' and compiler silently applies only width.
A 6/12 image becomes 8/12 while its 6/12 sibling remains 6/12.
Spacing intent writes padding/margin CSS strings outside token authority.
Mobile visibility request mutates desktop because current viewport differs from explicit phrase viewport.
A plan compiled on revision A applies to revision B without fingerprint rejection.
Typography intent replaces text alignment, weight or wrap settings that were not requested.
V3 applies the plan while planning, creating an unreviewed mutation.
Readiness BLOCK finding causes Smart Intent to generate a repair, collapsing Smart Intent into Auto-Fix.
Maturity is promoted from Core-only proof while active V3 has no usable Smart Intent surface.
edgeCases: Selected heading with phrase 'make it bigger' resolves to typography because component context is unambiguous.
Selected image/media node with phrase 'make it bigger' resolves to grid width.
Selected generic container with phrase 'make it bigger' remains UNKNOWN unless width language is explicit.
Two supported viewport words in one phrase produce UNKNOWN.
Already-maximum width or spacing returns BLOCK with no operations.
Global spacing phrase on any selection changes spacingScale but no component-local style.
Whitespace phrase on non-container child targets its immediate grid/stack parent only.
Typography node has fluidSize rather than fontSizeRem.
Responsive reset on a viewport with no overrides is BLOCK/no-op.
Phrase uses accents, punctuation or mixed case but normalizes deterministically.

alternatives.summary: Build a bounded contextual parser/compiler over existing canonical Builder operations and adopt it in V3.
alternatives.reason: Provides user-level intent without probabilistic mutation authority or a parallel schema system.

alternatives.summary: Send every in-Builder edit request through the existing AI storefront generator.
alternatives.reason: Block 23 owns full draft template/copy generation, not contextual element operations, and would broaden authority/risk unnecessarily.

alternatives.summary: Translate text into arbitrary Page Schema/JSON patches.
alternatives.reason: Would bypass canonical setters, validation, responsive inheritance and guarded freedom.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing Builder, responsive, typography and global-style authorities are sufficient; Smart Intent should only compile to them.
specialistReviews.resolution: Implement one pure planner/apply adapter and no new mutation primitive.

specialistReviews.finding: Natural language can be ambiguous and stale plans can mutate the wrong document state.
specialistReviews.resolution: Finite grammar, UNKNOWN on ambiguity, source fingerprint binding and final Page Schema validation are mandatory.

specialistReviews.finding: Intent must feel direct but must not mutate while typing or hide what will change.
specialistReviews.resolution: V3 provides explicit plan then apply, displays interpretation/affected operations, and commits once through existing history.

specialistReviews.finding: Using diagnostics to choose edits would prematurely implement Smart Auto-Fix.
specialistReviews.resolution: Smart Intent may display no diagnostic-derived repair path; operation generation depends only on user phrase, document, selection and viewport.

challenge.finding: Context can safely disambiguate bigger as width.
challenge.resolution: Compile bounded width increase on current/explicit viewport.

challenge.finding: Context can safely disambiguate bigger as typography.
challenge.resolution: Compile bounded typography emphasis, not width.

challenge.scenario: Generic container says only 'make it bigger'.
Phrase requests width and whitespace together.
challenge.finding: One request contains independent edit families.
Naive target-only resize breaks the intended 12-column composition.
challenge.resolution: Plan 8/12 target + 4/12 companion in one atomic plan.

challenge.scenario: Plan source document changes before apply.
challenge.finding: Operations may no longer describe the visible state.
challenge.resolution: Fingerprint mismatch blocks apply before the first operation.

challenge.scenario: Phrase explicitly says mobile while Builder currently shows desktop.
challenge.finding: Current viewport must not override explicit merchant intent.
challenge.resolution: Exactly one explicit viewport term wins; multiple viewport terms return UNKNOWN.

challenge.scenario: Publish Readiness reports a visual blocker while user entered an unrelated intent.
challenge.resolution: Ignore diagnostics for planning; only explicit user intent compiles.

challenge.scenario: Selected node has unsupported typography component.
challenge.finding: Applying typography would bypass component authority.

challenge.scenario: Whitespace is already at maximum token.
challenge.finding: No-op must not be reported as READY.

proofPlan: Plan Before Code projected-scope and risk-budget proof before implementation.
Core parser matrix proves Hungarian/English normalization, context disambiguation, contradictions and independent multi-action rejection.
12-column adversarial proof verifies 6+6 to 8+4 pair balancing and all width bounds.
Token proof verifies spacing/global density outputs are members of existing canonical token sets only.
Typography proof verifies sanitized bounded changes preserve unrelated fields and support fluid typography.
Viewport proof verifies explicit mobile/tablet/desktop targeting and ambiguous multi-viewport UNKNOWN.
Freshness proof compiles a plan, mutates the source document independently, and proves apply rejects the stale fingerprint.
Authority-boundary proof scans Smart Intent Core/V3 for no AI gateway, publish, persistence, Publish Readiness repair, Visual Diff mutation or raw CSS/JSON patch authority.
Apply proof validates final document through validateStorefrontPageDocument and proves source input immutability.
Active V3 proof verifies separate plan/apply controls, READY-only apply and exactly one commitDocument call for application.
Maturity proof promotes only VX-SMART-INTENT and leaves VX-SMART-AUTOFIX non-PROVEN and Template #3 blocked.
Incremental replay, full Quality tests, TypeScript, production build, exact-head Template Factory proof, Completion Truth and lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Smart Intent deterministically converts bounded contextual merchant intent into explainable existing canonical Builder operations with UNKNOWN/BLOCK fail-closed semantics and no parallel mutation authority.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Ambiguous, contradictory or unsupported intent cannot produce executable operations.

requirements.requirement: Smart Intent plans bind to source fingerprint and apply only through existing canonical setters followed by Page Schema validation; stale, invalid or non-READY plans cannot mutate.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A plan compiled from a different page fingerprint cannot apply.

requirements.requirement: The active V3 exposes explicit Smart Intent planning and READY-only apply, and application enters ordinary Builder undo/redo history as one atomic document commit.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: V3 cannot auto-apply intent while typing/planning or bypass ordinary history.

requirements.requirement: Smart Intent completion does not implement or promote Smart Auto-Fix and does not authorize Template #3.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Diagnostics or pixel evidence cannot generate Smart Intent repairs, and VX-SMART-AUTOFIX remains non-PROVEN.

notes: Twelfth Brabus hardening wave. Publish Readiness is lifecycle-closed and PROVEN on parent e63e7eee5a2180b958f6c3e288de45aa504f8cd8. Smart Intent is intentionally distinct from Block 23 AI storefront generation and from future Smart Auto-Fix. Guarded Freedom remains authoritative: user intent compiles only to bounded existing operations; no arbitrary source code or schema patching. Template #3 remains forbidden until Smart Auto-Fix is also PROVEN.
